reviews.text: Well maintained walk along the beach. Some good bars and restaurants to be found here. Ignore the street sales people as they are not pushy and only want to make a living. Nothing wrong with that. Can recommend for a alternative place to walk instead of the Playa des Ingles.

reviews.title: Sand dunes and nudist beach
reviews.text: Hot sand in places and it burns so watch out - that's mainly near the dunes - basically big mounds of sand to climb up . Not exactly the desert but similar . Lots of nudists walking around on the beach . What can I say ? You won't miss them . Lots of shops and restaurants around . Buses available Good day out

reviews.title: Love It!
reviews.text: So beautiful everywhere. I would recommend to put on your walking shoes as the sand is so hot, you'll struggle to walk.

reviews.title: Great large beach
reviews.text: Clean, large and popular beach. Nice to spend the day with friends and family. Not crowded and the best in the whole Island. Better on weekdays.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Have spent many hours on this beach.A very big expanse of fine golden sand,and huge sand dunes edged by a azure blue sea and sky with a mountainous backdrop.A very mixed place to spend some time first clothed then nudist the far end of the beach before it turns the corner is predominantly gay.Along the beach are small kiosks selling soft/alcoholic drinks and food.You can rent daily sun loungers and parasols.The nudist beach is by far the best I have used,very clean and rubbish bins all the way along the beach. The whole beach is raked and cleaned through the night.If you don't intend to rent a lounger it's worth investing in a parasol from the shops near-by about 6 euros and lashings of sun screen,it gets incredibly hot the sand  is unbearable to walk on.The sea can get a little rough and the current can be strong,but very clear and warm to swim.The beach is patrolled by the local police,red cross and has look out life guards. I feel very safe using this beach. Saturday and Sunday it can get quite busy with many of the islanders using it too. Too  the rear of the dunes is a scrubby vast area it has many grasses and tamarisk trees growing,and many lizards scuttling about, it is a nice walk through to Playa del Ingles.Coming off of the beach there are showers (free)and foot/leg washers the sand is very fine and sticks like glue.A fantastic day out to chill in the gran canarian sunshine and to get a lovely tan.

reviews.title: Beach lovely and clean not much activity in the area.
reviews.text: A big shopping centre called yumbo, bars in the town & eating places, but we were all inclusive so only got drinks while we where out.

reviews.title: Beautiful view and quality walk around the sand dunes
reviews.text: Walked along to Playa de Maspalomas one evening from our hotel in Playa de Ingles. Lovely clean beach with views right across over the sand dunes. Plenty of things to do in the area whether it be activities on the beach, wandering around the shops or eating in the restaurants. I imagine the sand would get hot around midday and always worth watching where you stand as it can be quite rocky!

reviews.title: nice
reviews.text: nice but vert small few top of the rang shops and some gift shops light house and nice prom to walk along

reviews.title: Holiday 10 days.
reviews.text: Briillent  stayed rui place hotel 4 star. Could not fault it . A very beatitfu location , hotel grounds and  facilities great. Tip use taxies they are cheap . Hire cars waste of money and  load of grief risk accidents.  I would go back with my family 12 yr old  boy and wife.A lot of good shopping  go to the market on Monday or Wednesday.  Will be going back again .Ps if you are looking for traditional Spanish fish an chips all day breakfast.  This is not the place for you. Steve.

reviews.title: Lovely Clean Beach
reviews.text: Lovely clean beach compared to playa del inglesOnly niggle be careful i ran in and nearly broke my ankle as was big rocks under water.we moved up a bit more and was much better.Very Very hot so apply sun cream regular.

reviews.title: Nice walk around the Dunes.
reviews.text: Good place for a walk, just be aware that the sand can get very hot mid day onwards.  Worth a visit if you are in the area.

reviews.title: Sample of the Sahara
reviews.text: If you are on holyday in Gran Canaria, a visit to the sand dunes and beach of Maspalomas is a MUST! Perfect clean water smaller waves and beautiful sand all around. Walking among the sand dunes are more enjoyable preferably in the 'winter' months.

reviews.title: What a stunning view
reviews.text: Had a stop over here on our Jeep Safari day tour. The dunes across the beach looked so beautiful. There were a lot of families making their way to the beach armed with their coolers etc.

reviews.title: A neverending beach turning into a huge desert
reviews.text: Seriously, it's bigger than it seems. Try have a walk across the desert. You will well deserve a swim in the sea at the end of your trip. :)

reviews.title: Lovely sandy beach
reviews.text: Lovely afternoon on the beachSun beds 2.50euro and umbrellas the same loads available Lots of lovely restaurants along here too so could do a full day and night

reviews.title: Long walk from playa del ingles
reviews.text: Long but energetic walk for about 1.30 hours through two nudist sun areas....lots to see and climbing sand dunes a must for the younger at heart

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Never been on a beach as clean as this before. Got very burnt. They don't advise Factor 50 for the fun of it!!!

reviews.title: Wonderful Dunes
reviews.text: Beautiful expanse of soft sand dunes. You can walk up a dune for panoramic view which cover a long distance. Also can view the sea which is some distance. We were staying nearby so visited them twice,

reviews.title: Lovely Sand
reviews.text: The beach is excellent, lovely soft sand. If you like swimming in the sea beware, some of the waves are very energetic.The beach is very clean and there is a nudist are if that is your thing. Sunbeds and brollies 2.50 euros eacjh from 9 till 5.  The dunes are great to walk across (there are some nudists there too).

reviews.title: Fantastic beach - but look out for the nudists!
reviews.text: What can you say about Maspalomas beach? As fantastic as it was the first time I came here 30 years ago. Incredibly hot if you choose to walk through the dunes do take a drink. You will likely stumble upon the nudists who are fairly brazen in the dunes and on parts of the beach so be prepared.

reviews.title: great beach
reviews.text: A great clean beach for a family visit.lots of places to eat and the option of sun beds or sitting on the sand.surf board hire is on the beach as well.Good shops with in a short walk.

reviews.title: Dunes
reviews.text: These sand dunes are fantastic ,although you are meant to follow a path though them the fence was broken and flattened in places, its to protect the wildlife that live there.I found it was much too hot to go across between 10 am and 6pm. Certainly worth a visit .

reviews.title: Nature at its best
reviews.text: We travelled here on the Global bus from Puerto Rico during our holiday.  I wanted to see the dunes for myself after reading about them.  It was very hot and i would advise you to bring plenty of water.  Enjoyed pretending we were all in a real desert.  A nice half day spent here.

reviews.title: Great to see and the kids loved it
reviews.text: Visited the dunes and beach while staying near Maspalomas. We visited the dunes at night and the beach during the day. The beach looks great but it quite rocky in places so wear beach shoes to stop your feet getting hurt.

reviews.title: WOW !! Still stunning after 28 years
reviews.text: We walked these wonderfully breathtaking dunes twice on our recent visit. They are still stunning after our last visit 28 years ago. Take enclosed shoes/trainers to wear. The sand is extremely hot. Get your cozzy on and slap the suncream on very thickly and walk. You will get the most amazing suntan. Oh and dont forget to take and drink plenty of water. It will take around an hour even at the shortest point. It's very deceiving how far the sea is away. Oh and hopefully you won't be shocked by the number of naked human beings when you get to the sea. It is a nudist beach afterall. Your sunglow should hide any embarrassment you may experience. OH MY WORD there were some sights. Hahahaha

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: The sea beach hotels walking boulevard and especially the sand dunes are fantasticWe have been here in winter and summer never disappointed!!!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach to have a stroll on especially after dinner when it is a bit cooler with your partner letting the water soothe your feet as you walk. Very safe but if you have small children with you be careful how far you walk as they might see more than you would like if you go as far as the nudist section. Each to their own

reviews.title: Brilliant walk
reviews.text: It is beautiful to walk from Faro to Playa Ingles One area close to the Faro is nude section of the beach - be considerate

reviews.title: Best beach in Gran Canaria
reviews.text: This was the first beach we went to, and was the best. Clean sand. clean water. They have sand dunes a bit further down. There is a lighthouse. Hard to get a sun bed here unless you arrive early as this beach proves to be quite popular. We put towels down and relaxed while our daughter played in the sand and the sea. Really lovely day, also they have various restaurants and shops around the beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful sandy beach
reviews.text: This sandy beach starts at the lighthouse and extends to playa Inglese. The lighthouse end is a family beach with kids having great fun playing in the sand and surf. Here there are shops, bars restaurants and some basic beach showers and foot washing. There are is a lifeguard watchtower and red cross post. There are some further beach bars and sunloungers for hire. It becomes a nudista beach further up and much quieter if you wish to get nuddy or escape the much busier family beach. Something for everyone.

reviews.title: Lovely sand
reviews.text: Lovely beaches ,yellow sand but heavy so dont have to clean yourself and towell off sand.Also good if you want to go topless or even nude near Kiosk 4.

reviews.title: Huge beach
reviews.text: Lovely big beach, very clean, will definitely be going back there, the sand dunes were amazing and lots of lovely restaurants and bars close by

reviews.title: Lovely Place!
reviews.text: Definitely the best beach in Gran Canaria. Would strongly recommend for everyone to visit as the sand dunes are breathtaking.

reviews.title: Beautiful classy resort
reviews.text: Love this place..stunning hotels..wonderful beaches..up market shopping and stunning views.lovely bars to just chill and relax in..have come here several times now and resort remains pristene and beautifully maintained.

reviews.title: Nice walk and views
reviews.text: Lovely walk from Playa des Ingles all the way to the lighthouse along the beach/dunes. Just be aware it is pretty much a full walk of nudist beaches so be aware of what can't be unseen ever again! My 11 year daughter hasn't slept since lol

reviews.title: Stunning beach and dunes
reviews.text: The beach and dunes at Maspalomas are always stunning and relaxing. It's always clean and very safe. The waves and under current can get tricky at times, but in the ocean people should always be careful and mindful of children. Though the atmosphere is completely different in the winter and summer, both times of the year are great. I do prefer Gran Canaria in the winter, there are more retirees and people wanting to get out of the cold and dreary weather in northern Europe. It's a quieter and more laid back experience. In the summer, there are more families, children and noise. Though there are often lots of people, the beach is large enough to always be able to find a quiet spot. I love walking from Maspalomas to Playa del ingles along the shoreline. It stretches more than 5K. The dunes are also stunning and very interesting. You feel as though you are in another world. Definitely bring a couple of bottles of water and decent flip-flops in the summer. In the winter, spring and autumn the sand is cool enough to walk barefoot. I'm always amused when I read reviews here of people who aren't prepared for nudists and gay people in Maspalomas. That is what Gran Canaria is all about and people are attracted to the island by the live and let live attitude. Those offended should probably look elsewhere to holiday. Maspalomas beach is probably the main attraction of Gran Canaria and well worth the walk.

reviews.title: Not enough sunbeds
reviews.text: Beautiful beaches but not enough sunbeds....not much good if you are disabled in any way....very very busy location

reviews.title: Beautiful, uncrowded beach.
reviews.text: Easiest way in is via the Lighthouse area in Maspalomas. Beach bars doted along the beach. Clean and warm sea. Nudist area a 15 minute walk away from lighthouse.

reviews.title: Dunes are spectacular
reviews.text: The dunes are spectacular and not something I expected from Gran Canaria. Worth a visit and take plenty of water!

reviews.title: Mountains of the Moon
reviews.text: amazing sand dunes unspoilt and not really crowded despite loads of trippers. Quite a long hike to lots of facilities

reviews.title: Best golden beach sand on the island
reviews.text: It is a must see while on the island. I would rated it as the main attraction of gran canaria. We were there on a windy day and my girlfriend was annoyed by the sand because it was flying everywhere. Besides that you should know that there are many nudists around there. If you don't mind this two things that you will love the place. It is great for photos, desert photos and beach photos.

reviews.title: superb but take supplies
reviews.text: Fabulous area although it gets incredibly hot. You HAVE to take supplies of water and a hat. If you do go wandering be aware that there is a specified 'gay'area and this is not for youngsters

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Nice sandy beach. Will have to be aware of your taking families that there is plenty on nudists around, but if that doesn't faze you it's perfect setting for a afternoon or day at the beach

reviews.title: worthwhile visit
reviews.text: an easy walk from Meloneras, where we were staying. good to experience sand dunes, although very, very hot. take a hat and water! glad we went.

reviews.title: This place is nice
reviews.text: One of the most warm places at Canarian. You can really enjoy the big sea line, desert, shops and restaurants around. Ive been here three times and will visit it again!))

reviews.title: Good waves, busy beach
reviews.text: Nice beach. Friendly people, big waves (sometimes), not too expensive drinks on the beach. If you go up to the restaurant to have a lunch, choose the restaurant carefuly. Do not accept the first guy offer who just pushing you to have a lunch at his restaurant. If you walk more far, you will find better prices and more warm welcomed staff. I would recomend.

reviews.title: An experience!
reviews.text: We recently stayed in a nearby hotel. The beach is clean, and very crowded up until 8pm in the evening. It was lovely walking by the water where there is a lovely breeze. The beach is divided into sections, some nude.We felt entirely safe here. The atmosphere was people having fun. very pleasant.Would I stay the whole day? Probably not, space was limited and the sand was sticky and black. It was nice to visit for a short while.

reviews.title: Something for everyone
reviews.text: We didnt stay in Maspalomas but we visited twice to eat and use the beah. The area itself is huge and there are some great shops-low end to very expensive. The beach was very busy but there were spots to sit . We walked along the seafront and went to the dunes which were empty of people and peaceful...we ate in a couple of different restaurants. Excellent food and 26 euros for 2 with drinks. Too touristy for me and too busy but worth a visit

reviews.title: Very nice beach
reviews.text: Very nice beach. The sand in the south is very hot and the water is pretty cool. Strong wind makes tanning easier, but after 16 o'clock sometimes sand storms appear.

reviews.title: Hot hot hot
reviews.text: Came here in June, the average temperatures were suppose to be around 21 however, we experienced between 27-33 on most days (and evenings).The beach is split into four areas;1) family (the largest section)2) partial nudist 3) gay community 4) nudist The beach is clean and scattered with plenty of seating. You need to hire the loungers and parasols between 09:00-17:00. The sand gets extremely hot as the day goes on so make sure to take flip flops if you intend on going in the sea to cool down. Like most tropical beaches be very mindful of the misleading breeze. Reapply sunscreen and cover up during the peak sun. Also pay attention to the UV index to determine when is best to stay in the shade.Best time to visit the beach is early morning or after 18:00 when the sand is cool. You can take a pleasant stroll along the beach with the sea lapping at your feet. The police patrolled the beach several times an hour in their 4x4 which was reassuring. There are also bins placed strategically along the beach to help keep it clean.Depending on where you are on the beach you can either take a couple minute walk (or longer) to the bars and shops for refreshments. If you'd rather stay put there are sellers patrolling the beach but obviously much more expensive (I overheard one sale - 6 euros for two cans of cola).

reviews.title: Stunning Dunes
reviews.text: The dunes area at Maspalomas (El Oasis) are a protected reserve. They are a stunning site on the south of the Island, stretching from Playa del Ingles to Meloneras.The sand here can get very hot so don't be tempted to go bare foot unless at the shore.The area is well known as a naturists haunt, so there will be many people with no clothes on at all...you get used to it!

reviews.title: A lovely clean beach with a few sights to behold!
reviews.text: We had a great walk along this beach. I'd thoroughly recommend it. It's about 4 miles from Maspalomas to Playa de L'inglese. It's a great way to get some exercise and the sand dunes are spectacular. Be warned though, it is a nudist beach and oh my we saw some sights!! The beach was beautifully kept and we saw very little litter. In fact two empty cans in the whole walk!

reviews.title: So peaceful
reviews.text: It was like being in the middle of the Sahara desert but with the sea nearby.  Beware the hot sand will eat your flip flops and give your calves a great workout!

reviews.title: It's 40 years since I last visited Maspolomas...
reviews.text: The dunes are still impressive, though the beach seems a lot blacker than previously. The walk across from the Rui Palace Hotel to the water is a good 30 mins, hilly, and soft, hot sand. BE WARNED, bare feet is not an option! It's  not easy if you're not reasonably fit! There is no direct access from the Duna Beach Bungalows, where we were staying.An alternative is to park your car (or get a taxi) to Calle Las Dunas, San Bartolome de Tirajana, 35100.  That's adjacent to the town beach of Playa del Ingles.  The walk along the waters edge is much flatter and firmer.  10 mins or so will get you to the FKK, naturist, nudist area though it's not compulsory..... Clothing is optional!A 30 to 40 minute walk will get you to 'Bongoland', which is essentially a gay area, though I gather there is a region too for swingers and so on....The dunes are not as big as I recall previously, and the stone circles seem to have largely disappeared.My wife and I enjoyed a nice day sunning on the beach, though I did notice close by, a young lady (alone) attracting unwanted attention from a solo male (nude) who insisted on displaying his wares. (Not very impressive! ).  Regrettably, these sorts of incident are fairly commonplace around naturist beaches, though the perpetrators are not naturists.... On the beach itself, there are a variety of 'stations' serving refreshments, typically ice creams and drinks, including alcoholic.  Prices are quite reasonable considering the logistics.To avoid unwanted attention, I would suggest staying in mainstream areas, or close to the water where there is an almost continual stream of folk, walking between Playa del Ingles and the Faro lighthouse at Maspolomas.

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: Visited this beach during my holiday in Gran Canaria this year and thought it was fab. Lots to do on the beach such as jet skis and paragliding. It was €9 to hire two sun beds for the day which I don't think is too expensive. The sea was lovely and clear and could see the fish swimming around my feet. Would go back again if ever on holiday here.

reviews.title: Dunes
reviews.text: A great place to visit, just come back from a holiday there, loved it well worth a visit to see them amazing

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: What a beautiful  beach, it was very busy there when  we  went for the  day.  Plenty  of bars on the  beach for  thirsty people.

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Lovely beach plenty of eating and drinking places all on all very enjoyable would definitely return if in gran Canaria

reviews.title: Excellent beach
reviews.text: The beach in maspolomas is really good however I would advise not swimming too close to the light house one side is all rock and the other towards the dunes you need to go 200 yards to escape partial rocks and sharp coral I found out the hard way. That said I would recommend maspolomas beach. If you like a good walk you can follow the beach all the way to Playa del Ingles .

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: We stayed here over a couple of weeks in June of this year,it's a lovely resort with lovely rolling sand dunes and beautiful beaches, the sunshine is guaranteed,

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: Lovely beach. Sand dunes look great especially from a distance. We didn't walk across them cos it was too warm. Definitely worth a visit.

reviews.title: Something to behold
reviews.text: Miles and miles of sandy dunes - kept liking for camels or sand buggies but none to be seen. People all packed with brollies, towels and picnics children in tow all trekked across the dunes to finally arrived at the most beautiful clean Sanyo beach and blue blue sea. At times waves came I  quickly but lifeguards on duty. Fabulous place to spend a good few hours just chilling. Worth a visit

reviews.title: Beautiful beach etc.
reviews.text: Beware of ladies selling bracelets - they are very aggressive!  Got rather nasty when told them not interested and had a vice like grip on our wrists.

reviews.title: Amazing but lots of nude homo men
reviews.text: Dunes are pretty amazing but when You go farther there is a lot of gays and nude people. Plenty of space to get rest.

reviews.title: Dunes
reviews.text: Day trip to the dunes from cloudy Las Palmas and thoroughly enjoyed it. It was very hot and totally opposite to the north of the Island! It was this day trip that caused us choose Puerto Rico when we returned a few months later.

reviews.title: Maspaloms
reviews.text: Maspaloms is so beautiful place and amazing shopping and also lovely restaurants. And the Beach is so beautiful 😍

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Lots of sea front restaurants with and lots of different types of foods only walked through as your get hassled into the restaurants lots of German restaurants seems to be that type of area

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: one of the best beaches I ever been to. the sand part before reaching the actual beach is absolutely amazing. stunning views and really really nice resorts.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Loved the beach we sat at paddy's Irish bar for a drink friendly service with a smile and a chat. You do get bothered by the bag and watch sellers. But if you know it's fake say so. Beach cleaned daily

reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: Lovely beach but man it's expensive. Bring plenty of euros for food n drink. No nitelife to speak of either. Sat nite n back at hotel 9.30!!!!!

reviews.title: Golf holiday
reviews.text: Maspalomaa is a flat resort with plenty to do on a low key no rowdy british or irish bars more good restaurants and cocktail bars for a quiet holiday good for families with the amusement park and a good beach

reviews.title: All creatures great and small
reviews.text: Really good beach. Very fine sand and plenty of nudity if that floats your boat. Wonderful stroll along the front for miles. Suitable number of beach bars interspersed along the way. Very clean as well with no rubbish and plenty of bins.  €7.50 for two loungers and a brolly. Worth it.Very shallow sea, but still swimmable. Best attraction in Masepalomas for a reason.

reviews.title: Glorious
reviews.text: Miles of clean sandy beach. No rowdy groups. Beautiful clear sea and big waves to enjoy. Nice little cafes and clean facilities.

reviews.title: Purpose built
reviews.text: Maspalamas is very pretty in parts , all very well done , plenty of shop's , bars , restaurants , café's , the outdoor cinema is based there plus plenty of other activities .But it is purpose built for tourists , nothing vaguely Spanish or Canarian here , no history or culture .If you want beach life , night scene , shopping and restaurants this is the place to be , some very high end hotels here beautifully done .Sand dunes are spectacular to see .

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Lovely views and great sands on this wonderful beach. Great restaurants and bars along the way. The natural.made sand dunes are a must see whisky in the area.

reviews.title: sand go on for ever
reviews.text: the beach and dunes are well worth a visit they seem to go on for ever a walk a long the water line is recommended, if your going to walk the dunes take plenty of water with you can be hard work walking on the dry sand hills

reviews.title: Camel Ride
reviews.text: A morning spent on the dunes of mamapoulous on a camel ride for 40 minutes the cost of €12 each and from sol y paz apartments a taxi cost us 25 euros each way. After the camel ride we bought a photo for €5 of which we felt was value for money the only downside was not much in directions to get to the place.

reviews.title: Southern tip of Gran Can
reviews.text: Nice resort featuring a working landmark lighthouse, plenty of shops , bars and restaurants, a long promenade for leisurely strolls. Large beach with watersports and a huge expanse of dunes which you can tackle Lawrence of Arabia style on camel or on foot. The dunes also host the naturist sunworshippers but there is plenty of waterside space for those who want to keep their costumes on.

reviews.title: WARNING hecklers!
reviews.text: Wanted people to read this as a warning. As soon as you're off the bus and past the main row of shops there are a crowd of African ladies who will say hello and try and entice you. Say NOTHING, make no eye contact and move on quickly with hands in pockets. Don't engage them. They managed to get hold of me and strap a tacky bracelet on to which I said I didn't want it, thank you and to let go of me. I walked away and she started to get aggressive, not realising I'm from Glasgow and wouldn't put up with her intimidation. I was polite but told her to stay away from me. She'd managed to heckle money from my partner because they try to separate you. There are police cars on the beach but looks like they turn a blind eye. Beach itself is overly crowded and feels touristy, not relaxing. The dunes are nice but overshadowed by this. It's a shame.

reviews.title: Amazing desert-like area
reviews.text: The dunes are amazing. It's such a vast area of sand, with such enormous dunes, that you really get the feeling of being in a true desert. There are small huts which sell water and soda, which you really need after walking about in the sand.

reviews.title: Long beach with great sand dunes
reviews.text: This is a nice long beach with large sand dunes at the end.It's a very nice beach but it does get very busy so you may want to go towards one end. We found a nice cove in the afternoon slightly off the main section which was pretty quietThe sand dunes make this a highlight but remember to wear some shoes as the sand gets very hot

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: Lovely place to go for a walk with beach, shops restaurants, a lighthouse, lifeguard on duty on the beach lovely views you can walk to playa Del ingles along the beach would take a while though

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: Very nice place nice walk from hotel plenty restaurants and drinking spots lovely beach would recommend a visit here

reviews.title: Walk along the beach
reviews.text: Great long beach plenty of wonderful sand dunes.  Lovely walk along water edge.  Plenty of shopping opportunities.

reviews.title: Great for long walks exercise
reviews.text: Just really a very very long beach, but nice for exercise and a long stroll. Not really a beach-person, but was nice as I could several kilometers in the sun.Nice walk either to or from Playa del Ingles to Maspalomas. Good restaurants in both ends.

reviews.title: excellent family stay
reviews.text: Stayed here Oct, lovely complex, great staff might be returning, close to amazing sand dunes.plenty to do.visit the watermark and souix city must do

reviews.title: The dunes of Maspalomas
reviews.text: One of the best thing you can make in Maspalomas is to visit its dunes. I felt almost like in Afrika. :)

reviews.title: Tacky and rough beach
reviews.text: My wife and I decided to take a visit to the beach at Maspsolmas and were very disappointed with the overall experience. We found it cheap and tacky and an uneasy place to visit. We are not prudish but we're surprised how many naturists are on show whilst you walk along the beach in all shapes and sizes. We stayed for an hour and quickly returned to our resort hotel where we sunbathed with like minded people not voyeurists

reviews.title: One of the best beaches on Gran Canaria
reviews.text: It's easy to see why Maspalomas is one of Gran Canaria's most famous beaches. The dunes go on for miles and are part of a protected nature area. If you like you can go on a camel ride through the dunes if you don't fancy walking. Overall a great clean beach to spend a day. There are lots of little cafes and restaurants along the beach to eat. I would say though watch out for the gypsies who will try to put 'bracelets' on you and then force you to then pay for them. They sit on the boardwalk by the beach and approach you in groups and can be a bit intimidating. We found the best way to avoid them is to just walk with purpose past them and don't engage with them.

reviews.title: SPECIAL AND NICE BEACH!!
reviews.text: Very special and nice beach cos here is small desert + very very large beach ... sand is hot ... very long beach .. many people ... but i think everyone could enjoy when you go there...

reviews.title: Busy Busy.
reviews.text: Went for a walk along the beach here as many thousands of people do. The sand dunes do look great but make sure that you have something on your feet as the sand is very hot. The beach itself is very busy especially at the weekends when a lot of Spanish people come down to chill out. Water quality not that good. Lots of nudists further along the beach.

reviews.title: Wonderful resort
reviews.text: Really exclusive resort with a great beach, sand dunes and lovely shopping. The promenade is great for an evening stroll.

reviews.title: Crowded and dirty
reviews.text: I was quite disappointed when I visited the beach which backs on to the sand dunes. The beach was crowded and dirty and wouldn't return again. Ive never really been a fan of the beaches on gran canaria, lanzarote beaches are much more cleaner and ideal for swimming. The sand dunes are impressive however, which continue in to the distance and are worth seeing and taken snapping some pictures.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: Lovely but very windy. Had sunglasses on and sand still got in my eyes. If taking children and happens to be a windy day please make sure eyes are covered

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Lovely clean beautiful beach.We had a drink in a restaurant called Antonio unfortunately we found the guy a bit moody and our fizzy drinks were flat.We got the free bus from our hotel occidental margarita. There was a lovely little restaurant near the pick up point and they sold lovely ice creams.There was plenty of sun beds on the beach €7.50 for two.Watch out for the ladies walking towards the beach.They go to shake your hand and tie a bracelet around your wrist. Well more like a piece of string and then want money from you!We kept saying no but they wouldn't let go!We was silly and paid them They wasn't going to give us change from a 20And then only gave us 5 change So 15 for two pieces of string!Beware

reviews.title: Marie
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. Very clean. Sun loungers and parasols available. Very relaxing. Sand dunes worth a visit they are lovely.

reviews.title: Lovely Walk
reviews.text: We took the bus from Puerto Rico to Faro de Maspalomas around 30 minutes. The lighthouse is amazing by the way. Lots of eateries around and an up market shopping mall but we only stopped for a beer. Our aim was to walk along the beach to Playa del Ingles about 3 plus miles. We found that it was easier walking at the ocean edge than on the dry sand. The beach is very clean in fact in the whole of our walk we only noticed one piece of rubbish. There are places along the way to buy drinks etc although we did not use them. There is a warning that you are entering a nudist area and there were plenty. We remain clothed on this occasion. All in all a very lovely walk to help burn off excess holiday calories.
